concentration.definition_source: normalized HHI of absolute episode returns: (HHI - 1/N) / (1 - 1/N); zero when all returns are zero

content.episode_sharpe: mean daily return / sample stdev daily return * sqrt(252); zero when fewer than 2 returns or stdev is zero
content.episode_sortino: mean daily return / sample stdev of negative daily returns * sqrt(252); zero when fewer than 2 negative returns or downside stdev is zero
